errors.evidence: The chart's title is 'Beschäftigungsverhältnisse' (employment relationships), not 'Beschäftigungsrichtigkeit', which is an incorrect term. Furthermore, the chart is not exclusively about women; it also includes categories for qualification groups, immigrants, and older employees.

errors.text_span: Die x-Achse enthält die Kategorien [...] Die y-Achse nimmt Werte von 0 bis 2.000 an
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly swaps the axes. In this horizontal bar chart, the categories are on the vertical y-axis, and the numerical values are on the horizontal x-axis.

The description incorrectly uses the prefix 'Beschäftigungsfähigkeit' (employability) for all categories. The actual prefixes on the chart are 'Arbeitszeit' (working hours) and 'Erwerbstätigkeit' (employment).
This is a misreading of the category 'Erwerbstätigkeit: Qualifikationsgruppen'. The description invents the phrase 'ohne Kindergruppen' (without children groups).
The description omits one of the six categories shown in the chart. The missing category is 'Erwerbstätigkeit: Frauen mit Kindern bis 14', which has a value of 477.

errors.text_span: Alle hier dargestellten Balken sind mit der gleichen Horizontalen sortiert.
errors.evidence: This sentence is grammatically nonsensical and its meaning is unclear. It seems to be trying to state that the bars are sorted, but the phrasing 'sind mit der gleichen Horizontalen sortiert' (are sorted with the same horizontal) is incorrect and confusing.
